en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town surrounded by rolling fields and distant hills. The foreground shows harvested farmland with stooks of grain and a few trees, while the middle ground contains a compact town with houses, several factory chimneys, and a church tower rising above the rooftops. At the bottom-left corner, the caption "PULSNITZ i/Sa." is printed, indicating the name of the town.
